entities.name: Þorbjörn Hornklofi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Þórbjǫrn hornklofi was a 9th-century Norwegian skald and one of the court poets of King Harald Fairhair. His poetry has sometimes been regarded as a contemporary source of information regarding King Harald, although it is only preserved embedded within 13th and 14th century king's sagas.
